title: Mapping Cells Through Time and Space with moscot
tldr_zh: moscot 用低秩熵 OT/GW/FGW 统一四类单细胞 OT 应用，扩到 170 万细胞×20 时间点 atlas 规模，实验验证 NEUROD2
tldr_en: moscot unifies four single-cell OT applications via low-rank entropic OT/GW/FGW, scaling to 1.7M cells × 20 timepoints atlas, validating NEUROD2
